name: The Ritz-Carlton, Wolfsburg
positioning: Contemporary design hotel set within Volkswagen's Autostadt theme park in Wolfsburg
best_for: Travelers who want to stay inside the Autostadt theme park
Guests who like contemporary design and a spa with views of the historic plant

facts.text: The hotel's redesign by Elliott Barnes is a contemporary update of the original design concept created by Andrée Putman.
Guest rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the Autostadt or the historic Volkswagen plant, with minimalist, contemporary decor.
The Club Lounge is on the top floor, with a view of the Autostadt theme park.
Terra serves modern German cuisine using regional ingredients.
Aura is the hotel's breakfast restaurant, with seasonal breakfast variations.
The Lobby Lounge is a setting for afternoon tea, light dishes or cocktails.
Newman's Bar is the hotel's elegant bar.
The wellness area includes a floating pool, a fitness center and two saunas.
Use of the spa is included for overnight guests.
The spa uses Pharmos Natur skincare, whose formulations use fresh Aloe Vera in place of water.

highlights.text: The hotel is an integral part of Volkswagen's Autostadt theme park.
The spa has a view over the canal, docks and historic VW plant, and an infinity pool in the harbor basin.
The hotel is designed as an open circle.
Guided tours let guests explore the Autostadt's fully automated Car Towers up close.
The Ritz Kids program offers young guests a heated pool and kid-friendly meals.

considerations.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.
WhataHotel notes limited appeal for guests not interested in automotive culture.
WhataHotel notes an industrial city location rather than a traditional tourist destination.
